items.title: Paul Barbarin Interview, 1960-01-28
items.q: I wonder what happened to Guy? You don't know what happened to Wilton Krala?

ctx.x: Want me to put it back?
That's alright. I wonder what happened to Guy? You don't know what happened to Wilton Krala?
No, not now. I've forgotten. Should I ask in New York? I saw Fess Williams. He could have probably told me.
